name: gramity
description: Gramity — custodial DCA executor on TON mainnet. Onboarding must be completed in Mini App first. Withdrawal address is optional at onboarding and can be set later via set_withdrawal_address or Mini App; once set it is locked.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Returns portfolio summary with frequency, amount_usdt, status, next_cycle, cycles_completed, total_invested_usdt, agent_wallet_balance_usdt, can_run_now, can_run_next_cycle, withdrawal_address_set, and masked withdrawal_address (null if not set). If withdrawal_address_set is false, cycles are blocked until set_withdrawal_address is called.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Update an existing DCA strategy (plan must exist from Mini App onboarding). Standard: min $10, daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly. Quick Start: min $2, intervals 10s/30s/60s, 2 cycles on mainnet. Use quick_mode=true to switch. Does not set withdrawal address — use set_withdrawal_address if missing.

tools.name: pause_strategy
tools.description: Pause the active DCA strategy for a user.

tools.name: resume_strategy
tools.description: Resume a paused DCA strategy for a user.

tools.name: run_now
tools.description: Immediately execute one DCA cycle: Omniston swap → Tonstakers → STON.fi LP. Requires withdrawal_address_set=true. Fails with action=set_withdrawal_address if address not set yet.

tools.name: withdraw
tools.description: Send available USDT from agent wallet to user's withdrawal address. Requires withdrawal_address_set=true. Cannot change an already locked address.

tools.name: update_frequency
tools.description: Change how often DCA cycles run. Does not change amount or strategy.

tools.name: update_amount
tools.description: Change the USDT amount per DCA cycle. Min $10. Does not affect frequency.

tools.name: set_withdrawal_address
tools.description: Set the user's TON withdrawal wallet (EQ…/UQ…) when not yet configured. Optional during Mini App onboarding; required before DCA cycles or withdraw. Can only be called once — address is locked after set. Ignored if address already set.

ton_address.description: User's TON wallet (EQ… or UQ…). LP tokens and withdrawals go here.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Returns last N completed DCA cycles with amounts and transaction links.
